disclaimer: Unofficial demo assets. Commonwealth Bank of Australia brand artwork is used for visual fidelity only. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Commonwealth Bank of Australia.
note: commbank.com.au is unreachable from the restricted build environment, so the same artwork was pulled from public mirrors. Run scripts/fetch-brand-assets.sh to reproduce every file in this folder.

files.description: Full CommBank lockup — black wordmark with the yellow diamond mark. Used in the site header.
files.derivation: The source is monochrome (#838383 diamond body, #383838 facet and wordmark). Recoloured to the official palette — diamond #fecb26, facet #000000, wordmark #000000 — and the viewBox tightened to the artwork bounds.

files.description: Reversed lockup for the black footer and NetBank header.
files.source: Derived from the same wordmark source as logo.svg
files.derivation: Wordmark set to #ffffff. The facet uses the app's --color-cba-yellow-dark (#e0b000) because a black facet would disappear against a black background.

files.description: Flat black and yellow diamond mark used at compact sizes.
Gradient diamond mark used as the browser favicon.
